act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: (...Still some left. I need to hurry to the next location.)
Hold on.
...Lady Marionette.
Scrambling to complete the mission before the deadline, are we? This is quite unlike you, Odette.
I'm the Harbinger in charge of evaluating the status of this mission. As for my assessment... I imagine you know where this is going.
I apologize, Lady Marionette.
Hm, apology accepted. I understand your circumstances quite well.
I saw the poster for the Black Snow Swan. The performance is in a week. You must be putting a lot of time and energy into rehearsal.
Everyone has their limits, Odette. It's important to think those things through before accepting a mission. Are we clear?
Yes. I apologize, Lady Marionette...
Alright, alright. You've already apologized once, and I'm not here to lecture you.
In any case, I'm sure your efforts will bear fruit nonetheless. I've heard what people have been saying.
They praise your artistry, recognize your courage in constantly challenging yourself, and firmly believe that you will once again deliver outstanding work.
In truth, I'm also looking forward to your performance. But it's important not to let work fall by the wayside, yes?
...Yes.
Well, then I have nothing more to say. Just be more cognizant next time.
Yes, Lady Marionette. Please take care...
Ah, Odette. That reminds me.
Yes?
Good luck with the performance — Arlecchino and I will both be in attendance.
...Ah, okay. Thank you.
Today is the day of the Fatui mission evaluation, right?
Odette's been doing a pretty good job, so there shouldn't be any problems!
Hello, Odette. Oh, you're here too.
...Lady Marionette.
Sandrone? What are you doing here?
I should be the one asking you that, don't you think? I'm the Harbinger responsible for evaluating the status of this mission.
I didn't expect that to be your personal responsibility, Lady Marionette...
It's nothing. I just happened to have some time. Now, you two, butt out. This evaluation is internal Fatui business.
O—Oh... Okay...
Is there anything you need me to do, Lady Marionette?
No need. The evaluation is already complete.
...Huh?
This was a monster extermination mission, so all I needed to do was check the monster activity at the target location.
I had a look before coming here. You did very well. You pass. Keep up the good work.
...Thank you, Lady Marionette.
No use thanking me. You're the one who's been putting in all the work.
By the way, I saw the poster for the Black Snow Swan. How are the preparations going? You holding up alright?
Yes, thank you for the concern, Lady Marionette.
(Ugh! Communicating with the younger generation is like pulling teeth sometimes, especially with this one's personality... I understand your struggle now, Rosalyne.)
Well, if there's nothing else...
Ah, hold on.
Huh?
If I remember correctly... The area you were responsible for clearing out was a spot you frequented as a child, yes?
...Did you hear that from Rosalyne?
You could say that.
What I'm trying to say is... Well...
Ugh, whatever. No use beating around the bush. Take it from someone who knows, you can't change who you are on the inside. You just need to accept it.
It's just some free advice... Listen to your heart. Don't always keep those feelings locked away.
This isn't an order, or some attempt at moral grandstanding. If you don't find it helpful, feel free to pretend I never said anything.
If you'll allow me, Lady Marionette... you seem a bit different from before.
Do I? Hmph, I'm assuming you mean that in a good way?
I do, and thank you for the advice. I'll keep it in mind.
Alright, then that's all from me. I often have Arlecchino over for tea. You should join us sometime.
If that makes you uncomfortable in any way, invite Lyney and the others along, or {NICKNAME}. It's no extra work on my part. Just a few additional tea settings.
Understood. Take care, Lady Marionette.
You're done talking? How'd it go?
I passed. Our conversation was... even more rewarding than expected.
